body.p: In response to the Office Action mailed on November 6, 2024, Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration based on the above claim amendments and the following remarks. Applicant respectfully submits that the claims as presented are in condition for allowance. Claim Objections
Claims 2, 5, 9 and 11 were objected to because of informalities.

Claim 15 was rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 112(d). Applicant notes that claim 15 covers an aircraft. Claim 1 uses the term aircraft but does not require an aircraft to infringe. Also, claim 1 has been amended to make clear that is directed to an aircraft solid state power controller (e.g., it no longer starts with the work "Aircraft"). Thus, claim 15 is believed to be a proper dependent claim.

Claims 1-14 and 16 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Nakahara, et al. (U.S. Publication No. 2016/0311327, herein "Nakahara") in view of Handy, et al. (U.S. Patent No. 11,101,643, herein "Handy").
To overcome this rejection, claim 1 now requires that the bypass controller is configured to switch the bypass switch on before the solid state power switching device is switched on; and

p.u: the bypass controlled is configured to switch the bypass switch off
the second bypass diode drops below the bus voltage (Uo).

body.p: This requirement finds support at least in paragraphs [0065] (bypass switch before SSP switching device), [0068], [0070] and [0073] (Ubreak2 falls below bus voltage).
Applicant does not observe any teaching of such a bypass controller.

By operating as now claimed, a short circuit of the power supply can be avoided by as the bypass switch 18 is turned off before the breakdown voltage (Ubreak2) of the second bypass diode drops below the bus voltage (Uo). Such a drop in breakdown voltage can be the result of current flowing through the second bypass diode. Applicant does not observe any teaching of such a short circuit in the prior art. As such, without recognition of the problem as taught in the current disclosure, there is no motivation to solve the short circuit issue.
Thus, as amended, claim 1 is now allowable. All other claims depend from claim 1 and, thus, are also allowable.
In view of the foregoing amendments and remarks, it is submitted that the application is now in condition for allowance. Such action is therefore respectfully requested.

If a communication with Applicant's Attorneys would assist in advancing this case to allowance, the Examiner is cordially invited to contact the undersigned so that any such issues may be promptly resolved.

The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any additional fees that may be required for this amendment, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 08-0385. In the event that an extension of time is required, or may be required in addition to that requested in a petition for extension of time, the Commissioner is requested to grant a petition for that extension of time that is required to make this response timely and is hereby authorized to charge any fee for such an extension of time or credit any overpayment for an extension of time to the above-identified Deposit Account.
